keyVerseDR: "Go, and do thou in like manner." (Lk 10:37)

level1.title: The Good Samaritan
level1.story: A man was hurt and left by the road. A priest and a Levite walked past. A Samaritan stopped, bandaged him, and took care of him. Jesus said, "Go and do the same."
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
level1.prayer: Jesus, help me be a good neighbor. Amen.

activity.title: Spot the difference
activity.intro: Find 5 differences between the two pictures of the Good Samaritan.
activity.scene: The Good Samaritan helping the hurt man by the road to Jericho

level2.title: Who Is My Neighbor?
level2.story: A lawyer asked Jesus, "Master, what must I do to possess eternal life?" Jesus asked what the law said, and he answered, love God with all your heart and your neighbour as yourself. "And who is my neighbour?" he asked. Jesus told of a man beaten by robbers; a priest and a Levite passed by, but a Samaritan had compassion, bound up his wounds, and took him to an inn. Jesus asked who was a neighbour, and the lawyer said, "He that shewed mercy on him," and Jesus said, "Go, and do thou in like manner."
level2.keyLine: Go, and do thou in like manner.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why did the others pass by?
Who is hard for you to see as a neighbor?
level2.prayer: Jesus, make me a good Samaritan. Amen.
